spec_match.rationale: Replays the exact documented contract — both stable error strings, the all-or-nothing rule including the runtime_allowed_hosts non-exemption, and the pre-155 mid-session failure mode — sourced from the chrome.debugger reference's enterprise-policy section.

interactive.rationale: Pattern textarea with live validation, target URL with live match readout, policy toggles, version toggle buttons, and a replay that renders a per-command timeline; the match-pattern engine is real code executing in-page.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index describes real pattern matching plus a labelled simulation of the attach verdict; the page opens with exactly that framing in its note.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers blocked-but-non-matching targets (the surprising all-or-nothing case), screenshot-only restriction, DLP vs DisableScreenshots, invalid patterns, and the no-restriction baseline in both eras.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5072259281715200, the debugger reference, and the match-pattern grammar doc.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite mirrors this page: the page-observable boundary as script assertions and the managed-browser contracts as manual assertions with concrete verification steps.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP matrix both classes with autorun replay; desktop screenshot read (rejection card, valid-pattern verdict, aria-pressed state on the 155 button); zero console errors. The extension-side contract itself is not runnable from a page, which the page states rather than fakes.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts on every replay with mode and policy-state details.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; pass/fail borders with AA text colours; pressed buttons use accent-blue with ivory text (7.9:1).

accessibility.rationale: aria-pressed on the version toggles, labelled textarea/inputs, aria-live pattern and match readouts, timeline as a labelled ordered list with text verdicts, 44px targets and 26px checkboxes in tall labels.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No overflow at 360×740 DPR3 or 1280×800 via CDP; long patterns wrap with overflow-wrap:anywhere.

openQuestions.title: Confirm the two error strings against a real managed Chrome 155 build
openQuestions.detail: The strings 'Host access is restricted by policy.' and 'Screenshot capture is restricted by policy.' come from the developer.chrome.com reference. When a managed 155 profile is available, run a scratch extension calling attach() under both policies and confirm punctuation/casing verbatim, since developers will string-match them.

guidanceConsulted.query: multi step interactive walkthrough state machine accessible buttons
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer declarative button-to-action wiring where a target element toggle suffices; otherwise native buttons with explicit pressed state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Exception recorded: the version toggle drives a full re-render (not a simple show/hide target), so invoker commands do not fit; native buttons with managed aria-pressed are used instead.

guidanceConsulted.query: live status readout panel accessible aria-live updates
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce validation and result changes via polite live regions; never encode outcome in colour alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Pattern verdicts, target-match line, and summary are aria-live; every timeline row carries an 'ok —' or 'REJECTED —' text verdict.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data readout grid mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: auto-fit form grids; wrap, don't clip.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: grid2 auto-fit; monospace rows use overflow-wrap:anywhere.

summary: The centrepiece concept: deterministic 155 gate vs pre-155 chaos, with a real match-pattern engine and clearly-labelled simulated verdicts. Runtime-verified on both classes; the verbatim error strings await confirmation on managed hardware.
